findings.title: Backup path is checked/created then closed and reopened by SQLite
findings.source: Coordinator authenticated GitHub readback for same-SHA checkrun120816951394, CodeQL high-severity FAIL at line181. Reviewer source confirms check/close/reopen pattern.
findings.cause: existsSync/realpath and exclusive open(wx) only validate the earlier path. The placeholder FD is closed before await backup(db,backupPath), which resolves/reopens the name; an attacker-controllable directory can replace it and redirect backup before later digest readback. Logical equality after write cannot undo writing the wrong target. This was a declared r2 limitation, now an explicit failing CI adoption gate.
requiredCorrection: Remove the externally writable check-close-reopen backup lifecycle without suppressing CodeQL or weakening tests.

Use a supported descriptor-based destination, or create the SQLite backup inside a newly owned/private0700 directory with controlled ancestry; verify there, then atomically publish without clobbering an existing final path (for example exclusive link rather than overwrite rename). Preserve artifact identity through verification and publication; keep the offline-source/operator boundary explicit.

Add deterministic race tests for replacement/symlink swap between planning, placeholder creation and backup open, plus destination already present/dangling symlink and concurrent replacement. Original DB and an unrelated sentinel destination must stay unchanged on refusal; no partial alias commit.
Re-run focused suite and same-SHA CodeQL after implementation; hold adoption/merge until the failing gate is resolved.
